invariants.text: Category.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.category_id must reference an existing Category.id
A product must belong to a category that exists in the system before it can be added.
A product's SKU must be unique across all products in the system.
The stock_qty of a product must be greater than or equal to zero after any restock or update operation.
A product is considered low-active if its low_active field is true, and this state does not affect stock or reorder thresholds.
The total stock value by category is calculated as the sum of (price_cents * stock_qty) for all products in that category.
A product is included in the low-stock report if its stock_qty is strictly less than its category's reorder_threshold.
The list_products method returns products filtered by category_id if provided, and optionally only those with stock_qty below the category's reorder_threshold if low_only is true.
When updating a product, if the category_id is changed, the new category must exist in the system.
The product with a given ID must exist in the system before it can be deleted or updated.
The low_stock_report method returns only products whose stock_qty is below the reorder_threshold of their category.
